title: field_ops.inventory.moved v1
description: One movement of the inventory book of a truck (ADR-37 §18.4): stock loaded, sold, returned, lost, transferred between trucks, counted, or used on a field order. The book (field_ops.inventory_movements) is append-only and the truck's stock (field_ops.truck_inventory) is its projection, moved in the same transaction. Emitted once per movement AFTER the transaction that wrote it commits; a retried write (same client_change_id) is not announced again. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :inventory, :moved] telemetry event that InventoryLedger.announce/1 fires. The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data` (telemetry metadata stringified, measurements prefixed with m_).

movement_id.description: The field_ops.inventory_movements row. Stable: a consumer dedups on it.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the truck (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

context_id.description: Branch (context) the movement was recorded in, when known.

technician_id.description: Whose truck: the field technician or salesperson that carries the stock.

part_id.description: field_ops.parts_catalog row (a copy of a Catálogo item when the tenant uses Catálogo, ADR-37 §18.6).

kind.description: What happened. Positive kinds: opening, load, sale_cancelled, customer_return, transfer_in. Negative kinds: unload, sale, shrink, transfer_out, part_used. adjustment (a physical count) can go either way.

quantity_delta.description: Units added (positive) or taken (negative); never zero. Its sign matches the kind.

balance_after.description: The truck's balance of this part right after the movement; never negative.

document_type.description: What caused it: sale, settlement, field_order, transfer, manual, migration (the opening balance) or direct_write (a write to the projection made outside the book, captured by a database trigger).

document_id.description: The document's id (the sale, the field order, the transfer...).

transfer_id.description: Pairs the transfer_out and transfer_in of one transfer between trucks.

occurred_at.description: When it happened (ISO-8601). From the phone when captured offline; the server's time otherwise.
